**Test image observations:**
- Single leaf with severely ragged, irregular margins
- Brown necrotic tissue predominantly at the leaf edges/margins
- Central leaf tissue remains somewhat green
- Overall leaf shape is distorted with torn/jagged appearance

**Cutting_Weevil reference analysis:**
The reference shows clean stem cuts (petiole/stem severing), leaving triangular stubs. This is distinctly different from the test image, which shows marginal leaf damage — not clean stem cuts.

**Reasoning through remaining candidates:**
- The test image shows marginal necrosis with irregular, coalescing brown lesions along the leaf margins — a pattern highly characteristic of **Anthracnose** on mango
- Anthracnose causes dark brown/black irregular spots that coalesce and cause leaf distortion
- Die_Back would show browning from tip inward on shoots; this is a detached leaf with edge damage
- Powdery Mildew would show white powdery coating — not present
- Sooty Mould would show black sooty coating — not present
- Bacterial_Canker/Gall_Midge have different characteristic presentations

The ragged brown margins with green central tissue and distorted leaf shape best match **Anthracnose** lesion coalescence along leaf margins.
